rule: A target pins file, line, column range and full message of the first and only verifier error. Line numbers must be derived from a unique source anchor in the row's verified source, as _final_select_target does. A pin is valid only if the obligation is the one the control removes.

callee-false-normal.message: error: Cannot prove condition. (Cannot prove false.)
callee-false-normal.why_intended: Callee body cannot establish the injected `false` normal post; repeated identically in cfc83426 and 7e23e945.

callee-owner-duplicate.message: error: No matching heap chunks: [1/2]own(T_typeid)(tid, t)
callee-owner-duplicate.why_intended: Second retained half cannot be produced from one received half.

callee-owner-loss.message: error: Function leaks heap chunks: [1/2]own(T_typeid)(tid, t)
callee-owner-loss.why_intended: Dropping the half from the post leaks it at callee end.

callee-thread-duplicate.message: error: No matching heap chunks: thread_token(tid)
callee-thread-duplicate.why_intended: Second thread token cannot be produced.

no-retained-half.message_prefix: error: No matching heap chunks: points_to<*Element>(
no-retained-half.why_intended: Without the retained half only [1/2] of the payload cell exists, so the full-cell assert fails. The full message contains symbolic names (__result1); a prefix pin plus the exact assert anchor is proposed, subject to review.

omit-selected-own.why_intended: Omitting the selected wrapper close leaves the wrapper-select lemma's first ownership precondition unmet. This replaces the R21 classifier target (final-select result equality), which is stale for this route because the ownership gap is now detected earlier.

omit-unselected-own.why_intended: Same as omit-selected-own, for the second precondition conjunct (b).

open_questions: Whether the symbolic value suffixes (value6/value2/__result1) are stable enough to pin exactly, or only prefixes.
These diagnostics must be re-observed after the leak repair (LEAK-REPAIR-NEXT) changes the positive; pins are finalized only on that build.
The classifier change (select-callee-r21-fractional-proof.py) cascades the PROOF_HELPER_SHA256 pin in the entry; it needs independent review.
